dedupe_keys.name: bruegel european natural gas imports daily eu gas import flows by route and storage levels since 2022

description: This regularly updated data set from Bruegel aggregates daily data on European natural gas import flows and storage levels. It was first published on 16 June 2022 and was last updated on 10 September 2026. Figures show weekly extra-EU imports against the 2016 to 2020 range, imports by route (the Russian corridors Nord Stream, Yamal, Ukraine and TurkStream, Norway, Algeria, Azerbaijan, LNG and net imports from the UK), quarterly LNG imports by origin, regasification capacity use, daily imports for the last 30 days and storage levels. The technical appendix states that flows come from the ENTSOG API, matched to IEA import data with quality checks at each point, covering all extra-EU trading points except Switzerland and the Balkans, while LNG arrivals by origin use monthly Bloomberg ship data. Coverage is the European Union. Data are free: after a pipeline revision in September 2026, live data are downloaded from the graphs, and a legacy download button covers data up to 2 July 2026. Caveats: this is a derived aggregation of ENTSOG flows, LNG figures from ships and terminal send-out can differ, and no data licence is stated. Simulation uses are supply route disruption and security of supply scenarios for the EU gas system. Related records: data-entsog-transparency-platform and data-gie-agsi-alsi-gas-storage-lng-transparency are the primary flow and storage sources.
